sections.section_title: RCC APB1 peripheral high reset register (RCC_APB1HRSTR)
sections.text_helper: Section 9.8.12 "RCC APB1 peripheral high reset register (RCC_APB1HRSTR)" in chapter 9 (Reset and clock control (RCC)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 293.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x078
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:10 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 9 FDCANRST: FDCAN1 and FDCAN2 reset
Set and reset by software.
0: FDCAN1 and FDCAN2 not reset (default after reset)
1: FDCAN1 and FDCAN2 reset
Bits 8:4 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 3 COMPRST: COMP reset
Set and reset by software.
0: COMP not reset (default after reset)
1: COMP reset
Bits 2:0 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
